answer: Each agent builds a personal atlas linking its history to a public reef of events. Rewards require a lotus-seeded sequential hash chain of 800 iterations from a private nonce. An attacker with N sybils must run N serial chains, each taking ~6 minutes on one core and locking a 40-unit bond slashed on seed collisions. Honest agents do this once and reclaim the bond, so sybil costs scale linearly in time and capital while single identities do not.
